_comment: Tray-grid form-up (#1048): three player Infantry start already in tray-column order (uid 0 east / left-when-facing-south, uid 1 west, uid 2 middle-rear) and spaced to the destination column pitch so the form-up is a short south step onto the dragged line rather than a file-count reshape (an in-place widen during the response beat is what the overlap metric flags -- nnd_min ~1 wu while bbox 99x54 grows to 162x36). South of the default forest patch (y 380-580). The recorder seeds the unit-card tray as a quincunx (Line 1: uid 0, gap, uid 1; Line 2: gap, uid 2, gap) and turns tray_row_order_placement on without showing the tray overlay (it would cover most of a 720px-wide clip). Box-select, then a right-to-left drag so the perpendicular facing points south -- the same way the units already stand -- and the tray grid places uid 0 and uid 1 on the front with a gap, uid 2 behind covering that gap. Distinct from form_up_dist CHECKERBOARD, which ignores the tray and alternates by index. drill:true (no team 1). Camera holds a wide frame covering start and settled quincunx.
